operators.name: Paltel
operators.role: The main telecommunications company in Palestine, providing fixed phone lines, internet and data services.

operators.name: Jawwal
operators.role: The first Palestinian mobile operator, created by Paltel, which started the mobile phone era in Palestine.

operators.name: Ooredoo (Wataniya)
operators.role: The second mobile operator, which brought competition to the market and later reached Gaza in 2017.

operators.name: Ministry of Telecommunications (MTIT)
operators.role: The government body that regulates telecommunications and the internet in Palestine.
